objective: Add one owner-triggered deterministic move.to.v1 skill that turns toward and walks to an absolute X/Z target no farther than two blocks, then reports success only after normalized position evidence verifies the result.
non_goals: Do not add pathfinding, obstacle avoidance, retry, jump, sprint, combat, mining, block placement, inventory mutation or destructive actions.
Do not grant skill authority to the LLM, planner, viewer chat, widget, game text, sign, book or plugin payload.
Do not claim real resettable-server success; the owner will perform manual application testing after this slice.
Do not change Vision, Brain, STT, TTS, avatar, memory or resource scheduling.
contracts: move.to.v1 accepts exactly finite targetX and targetZ coordinates within the Minecraft world bound; current-state distance must be 0.25-2.0 blocks.
Execution requires online, emergency-stop clear, player present/on ground, no active skill and physics state no older than 1000 ms.
The controller turns once, holds only forward, makes one attempt within four seconds and always clears control state.
Twenty physics ticks without forward progress fail as blocked; there is no retry or pathfinding.
Success requires at least 75 percent target-axis progress, at most 0.75 block overshoot, at most 0.35 block lateral drift and bounded evidence.
Only the operator Desktop can invoke the fixed authenticated loopback route; POST is never replayed.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Minecraft adapter and Desktop dependencies only; no new dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Registry and request validation include exactly move.to.v1 with finite bounded coordinates and immutable one-attempt policy.
Deterministic tests cover diagonal success, too-near/too-far target, stale state, blocked movement, cancellation, timeout and failed postcondition.
Status service and Desktop expose a fixed owner-only move-to route and typed X/Z controls without renderer network or token access.
Minecraft build/tests, Desktop typecheck/build/tests, repository fast suite, module-brief validation, GitNexus detect_changes and git diff check pass.
No model, GPU, Cloud, real Minecraft server or retained runtime artifact is used by automated verification.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M09-S6-verified-target-coordinate-movement-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
